attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 4
attributes.name: Call Potion
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1d8 to any check to acquire an item that has the Alchemical or Liquid trait.

Discard this card to search your deck for an item that has the Alchemical or Liquid trait and draw it.

After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 6 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
